title: On-Column DNase I Treatment for ISOLATE II Biofluids RNA Kit
author: Bioline
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.f5ibq4e

steps.title: Prepare DNase I Buffer Mix
steps.instruction: Prepare a DNase I - buffer mix for each on-column digest.

substeps.instruction: Add 5 μL of the supplied DNase I Solution to 100 μL of DNase I Reaction Buffer DRB.
Mix gently by inverting the tube a few times; do not vortex.

steps.title: Perform Initial RNA Isolation
steps.instruction: Perform the appropriate RNA isolation procedure for the starting material up to and including the 'Binding RNA to Column' section (up to step 12 of Genomic DNA removal and total RNA purification from all types of lysate).

steps.title: Wash Column with Buffer W1
steps.instruction: Apply 400 μL of Wash Buffer W1 to the column and centrifuge for 2 min at 14,000 x g.

substeps.instruction: Reassemble the spin column with its Collection Tube.
Inspect the column to ensure the entire wash buffer volume has passed through; if not, spin for an additional minute at 14,000 x g.

steps.title: Apply DNase I Buffer Mix
steps.instruction: Apply 115 μL of the DNase I - buffer mix to the column and centrifuge for 1 min at 14,000 x g.

substeps.instruction: Ensure the entire volume of DNase I - buffer mix passes through the column; if necessary, spin for an additional minute at 14,000 x g.

steps.title: Recycle DNase I Mix
steps.instruction: Pipette the flow-through from the Collection Tube back onto the top of the column to ensure maximum DNase I activity and RNA yields, especially for small RNA species.

steps.title: Incubate Column
steps.instruction: Incubate the column at room temperature (18-25°C) for 15 min.

steps.title: Proceed to Second Wash
steps.instruction: Without further centrifugation, proceed directly to the second wash step in the RNA Column Wash section (step 15).

substeps.instruction: Apply the wash buffer directly to the column containing the DNase I - buffer mix.
